qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. with at least 1 year of postdoctoral experience. B.Tech./M.Tech equivalent in Electrical or Electronics Engineering. At least 3 publications in SCI-indexed Q1 journals. Experience in modeling and simulations (COMSOL/Ansys software), micro/nano fabrication and clean room protocols, design and fabrication of resonators for quantum applications, and superconducting vertical interconnects for 3D integration. Good academic records and communication skills.
qualification.details: Ph.D. with B.Tech./M.Tech equivalent in Electrical or Electronics Engineering. At least 3 publications in SCI-indexed Q1 journals. Should have experience in modeling and simulations (COMSOL/Ansys software). Should have experience in micro/nano fabrication and clean room protocols. Should have experience in the design and fabrication of resonators for quantum applications. Should have experience in superconducting vertical interconnects for 3D integration. The candidate should have good academic records throughout and good writing/communication skills. Ph.D. with at least 1 year of postdoctoral experience.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Hyderabad Postdoctoral Research Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Postdoctoral Research Associate position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Postdoctoral Research Associate position at IIT Hyderabad is 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. with at least 1 year of postdoctoral experience and a B.Tech./M.Tech equivalent in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Postdoctoral Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary offered for this position ranges from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 120,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for this position?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on shortlisted candidates' eligibility, academic record, and relevant experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply via email by sending their CV and cover letter.

faq.question: Q7. What specific experience is required for the Postdoctoral Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Experience in modeling and simulations (COMSOL/Ansys), micro/nano fabrication, clean room protocols, and design/fabrication of resonators for quantum applications is required.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Postdoctoral Research Associate position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Postdoctoral Research Associate position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job opportunity at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q10. What should be included in the email application?
faq.answer: The email application should include your CV and cover letter, with the subject line "POSTDOC in Quantum Applications".
